traits.anchorage_per_stem_kg.note: fgr 2020 (ForestGALES), species parameters for western hemlock: C_reg 158 N m per kg of green stem, the mean over its four soil groups and three rooting depths, from tree-pulling tests (Nicoll et al. 2006 and others, listed in the Critical Resistive Moments vignette). A species with its own pulling tests states its own.

traits.crown_drag_at_rest.note: fgr 2020 (ForestGALES), species parameters for western hemlock: crown drag coefficient on the silhouette Cd = C u^-N with C 1.51, N 0.68, fitted between 10 and 25 m/s, after Mayhead's (1973) wind-tunnel drag of whole trees and later studies (Streamlining and Drag vignette).

traits.note: Abrams (vol. 1, 1923, pp. 62-63), Tsuga: leaves mostly looking two-ranked through a twisted stalk (mountain hemlock excepted); seed cones stand up when young at the shoot tip, then mostly hang, ripening in their first season.
